title: Ivo and the Deadline
author: Rosalind Yarrow
blurb: Ulyana Zhou, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must extract a defector who may be the bait before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
